description:
"Taboo" is the lead single from Audrey Powne's highly anticipated debut solo EP "Bed I Made" set to be released August 2020.

Recorded in Brooklyn with producer Tariq Khan (Slingbaum, Bilal) and a collection of sought-after musicians from the New York scene, “Taboo" features Audrey as both vocalist and Trumpeter demonstrating her uncommon ability as both musician and writer to blend lyrical melodies with the freedom and flexibility of jazz. Heavily influenced by pioneering cross over artists like Meshell Ndegeocello and her idol, jazz icon Roy Hargrove with Taboo Audrey similarly seeks to establish herself beyond her virtuosity as an instrumentalist, as a stylish and confident composer and band leader.
